title: Nebula: Spiritual Guidance
description:
Whether you're deeply spiritual, casually curious, or simply craving guidance during a transitional season, Nebula is a great place to start your journey to self-discovery. - Brit+Co

Nebula: Spiritual Guidance Space is both your trusted psychic reading app and astrology app for spiritual self-discovery, offering personalized tools and expert guidance to help you feel seen, connected, and confident. Nebula app is designed to meet you where you are, fitting naturally into your life so you can move forward in deeper alignment with your true self.

Nebula is an astrology app with a useful features:
- Birth chart reader tool to calculate natal chart and zodiac chart.
- Zodiac compatibility calculator to test love match potential and romantic relationships.
- Daily horoscope to check daily zodiac sign trends and horoscope insights.
- Tarot card readings
- Palm readings to explore palmistry and hand lines on your hand
- Live psychic chat to connect with psychic advisors anytime.

Zodiac Compatibility and Relationship Guidance
Ever wondered who is a good match for you? With Nebula’s advanced compatibility tools, you can explore the potential connection between you and your crush, partner, or even that intriguing new friend. Discover how you align and understand the natural tensions that arise when your energies interact. These insights help you avoid toxic dynamics, build healthy relationships, and move forward in love with clarity.

Accurate Psychic Readings via Live Chat
Receive spiritual guidance from one of 900 trusted advisors available 24/7 for private psychic readings. Whether you need clarity in love, confirmation of your thoughts and plans, or simply to know that you’re moving in the right direction, you can feel confident that their insights are both gifted and grounded in respect — wisdom you can truly rely on.

Birth Chart and Astrological Profile
Deepen your self-discovery by exploring your personality beyond your Sun sign. Enjoy detailed descriptions of each placement in your birth chart and learn how they shape your unique perspective. Discover the core strengths that make you who you are, while gaining insights into the challenges and opportunities that lie ahead.

Daily Horoscope and Tarot Insight
Start your day with personalized daily guidance and a special Tarot "Card of the Day" for immediate inspiration and focus. Nebula is a psychic app that also tracks your biorhythms to provide a clear overview of your physical, emotional, and intellectual energy. By staying aware of your daily focus and mood percentages, you can better plan your day and align your actions with your natural internal cycles.
